title: PAIGC declares the independence of Guinea-Bissau
summary: On 24 September 1973 the PAIGC unilaterally proclaimed the Republic of Guinea-Bissau in the liberated zone of Boé; dozens of states recognised it within weeks. The territories layer ends the colony on 9 September 1974, the eve of Portuguese recognition, whereas this record is the unilateral declaration of 24 September 1973: for about a year two states claimed the same ground, and the map shows one of them.
